verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments platform, so monitoring failed payments and running dunning is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows generic APIs, subscription payment plans, and invoicing. Nothing documents webhooks for failed-payment events, automated retry logic, or dunning outreach, so these adjacent features do not count toward the story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach
